title: Sheinbaum Deflects 2030 Talk on García Harfuch; Mexicana de Aviación Reports Progress
detail: At her Oct 8 conference Sheinbaum answered Senator Manuel Velasco's proposal of security secretary Omar García Harfuch for 2030, saying he is dedicated full time to security and that no one in her cabinet is thinking of political aspirations. Mexicana de Aviación's director said the airline has raised seat supply 83% since June, carried over 1.2 million passengers and expects break-even from 2030. Sheinbaum also said the security cabinet is investigating a video of alleged Mexican cartel members in the Ukraine war, with no official confirmation of identities.
